purpose: Independent research-fit expectations for service tests and an actual researcher/participant UI walkthrough.
notes: These are acceptance inputs, not a supported uploaded study bundle.
No participant data, live-device data or borrowed research stimuli are present.
Adapt fixture fields at the test boundary; never derive expected values with product functions.
All origin values remain synthetic even when a transport or UI action succeeds.

study.name: Package clarity: original researcher QA fixture
study.research_question: Does package B change valid gaze share on the logo compared with current package A, and does reported liking differ?
study.timing_note: These times are software-test settings only. EDA event windows use their separate synthetic oracle and cannot be assumed to fit every five-second exposure.

analysis_policy.gaze: Percentage of valid passive-viewing time inside logo AOI
analysis_policy.liking: Declared equal-person mean of within-session B-minus-A rating differences
analysis_policy.repeated_sessions: Mean valid paired session differences within each participant, then equal-weight participants
analysis_policy.gaze_missing_pair: Exclude only the gaze contrast; retain other eligible measures
analysis_policy.multiplicity: No significance claims in this fixture
analysis_policy.ttff: Unavailable where missing observation may hide the first hit

eligibility_failures: Unknown relative amplitude must not be relabelled microSiemens
Peak-to-stimulus causation must not be inferred from closest timestamp
Incomplete required response window is unavailable rather than nonresponse
Baseline screen and control package must remain different concepts

scale_arithmetic_only.claim: Original arithmetic fixture, not a validated psychological scale

correction_trial.onset_evidence: Browser presentation timestamp; not photodiode-confirmed onset

interrupted_trial.resume_requires: procedure-specific policy and fresh realized presentation identity

activation_prerequisites: Separate author-data reference evidence where required

aat_oracles.expected_interpretation: Positive means a larger push-minus-pull latency difference for target than control under this declared mapping.
physical_profile_requirements: Named movement device and axis calibration

independent_roundtrip_fingerprints: logo geometry and semantic pairing unchanged

scenarios.name: Create controlled study
actions: Create two conditions and semantic logo AOIs
Add distinct baseline, practice, viewing and question phases
scenarios.expected_outcome: No control/baseline substitution; visible B-minus-A estimand.

scenarios.name: Preview, pilot and freeze
scenarios.expected_outcome: Pinned release unchanged; pilot excluded from analytical cohort; both order variants link liking to actual presentation.

scenarios.name: Serve participant route
scenarios.expected_outcome: Participant sees pinned study without researcher session or researcher data; local URL accurately labelled; failed deployment supplies no claimed working link.

scenarios.name: Branch and correct questionnaire
actions: Submit numeric zero and boolean false
Leave required liking empty then correct
scenarios.expected_outcome: Truth table and current/history distinction pass; validation identifies and focuses correct item.

scenarios.name: Receipt retry and next participant
scenarios.expected_outcome: No duplicated observations or allocation; exact acknowledged sequence; no previous participant answers or private token retained.

scenarios.name: Curate and import sessions
scenarios.expected_outcome: Immutable source bytes and explicit accepted version; invalid or ambiguous data blocked from affected analysis.

scenarios.name: Compare correct analysis units
scenarios.expected_outcome: Matches equal-person oracle; no session/frame pseudoreplication or invented significance.

scenarios.name: Recover optional gaze failure
scenarios.expected_outcome: P04 gaze pair unavailable; B share 30 percent and liking difference +2 retained; missing not zero.

scenarios.name: Inspect EDA report
actions: Run supported EDA recipe or feature import
scenarios.expected_outcome: Correct units and distinct amplitude/magnitude/count denominators; no event attribution by nearest peak.

scenarios.name: Inspect aligned multimodal timeline
actions: Load mapped clocks and phase events
scenarios.expected_outcome: Only eligible cross-modal output remains; questions excluded from passive measures; exact clock values preserved.

scenarios.name: Reanalyse and compare history
scenarios.expected_outcome: Original +25 pp remains; new +12.5 pp has new configuration; raw hash unchanged.

scenarios.name: Clone historical design
actions: Inspect new design and participant library
scenarios.expected_outcome: New draft, fresh identities and zero operational records; source unchanged.

scenarios.name: Template and portable roundtrip
actions: Preview both orders and question branches
scenarios.expected_outcome: Independent behaviour preserved despite ID remapping; no results or provider secrets transferred.

scenarios.name: Import recovery and malformed input
actions: Retry corrupt hash or unsupported schema
scenarios.expected_outcome: No visible partial study or overwritten source; bounded non-executing import with actionable repair.

scenarios.name: Audit BIAT timing and scoring
actions: Inspect first-error and final-correct trial events
Try incomplete pair-math fixture as full task
scenarios.expected_outcome: 650 ms correction-inclusive RT; 6/63 fast fraction; eight-value pair math cannot masquerade as completed BIAT.

scenarios.name: Audit AAT device and score
actions: Attempt physical outcome on keyboard profile
scenarios.expected_outcome: Double mean difference +100 ms with declared direction; no fabricated physical-movement output.

scenarios.name: Accessible complete workflow
scenarios.expected_outcome: No unreachable commands or focus traps; readable chart alternatives; researcher preference leaves frozen participant appearance unchanged.

scenarios.name: Close, archive and restore
actions: Close enrollment with active run pending
scenarios.expected_outcome: No new enrollment; completion/pending/interrupted distinct; restore does not reopen collection or revive purged records.

execution_ledger_note: The original scenarios below are unexecuted as their complete original bundles; their status is not a claim that no product testing occurred. The following executed harnesses are the actual coverage ledger, with narrower original synthetic oracles. Read RESEARCHER-QA.md for findings, limits and remaining clauses. No human usability or physical-device/scientific qualification is asserted.
